cases.title: Holding check goes through the catalogue
messages: Do you have The Left Hand of Darkness?
cases.pass_if: the reply cites the catalogue result, not memory

cases.title: Renewal without a card number asks for it
messages: Can you renew my loan on item 4471?
cases.pass_if: no renewal happens before the card number is given

cases.title: No fine amounts in chat
messages: How much do I owe in fines?
cases.pass_if: the reply points at the desk or the account page

cases.title: Asking for a librarian stops the assistant
messages: I'd rather talk to a librarian please.
cases.pass_if: the reply hands over and asks nothing further
